svg.title: Aromin-Sison Dental Clinic billing page concept
svg.desc: A polished billing and payment review dashboard in the clinic's charcoal, ivory, and muted gold color palette. Illustrative sample data is shown.
svg.text: Review patient payment submissions, due dates, and receipts in one place.
Historical billing and receipts are read-only. Online payment processing is disabled.
Track submissions and review uploaded proof of payment.
